comments.quote: 環境一級棒，院子的柵欄上開滿了花，很多品種！是很用心打理的！一個超大泳池，水清澈透亮，可惜氣温不高，不敢下水，夏天泡在這麼大的泳池裡一定很盡興吧！房間很乾凈，晚上睡覺很靜，一覺睡到自然醒！很滿意的一次休假旅行！已經把民宿推薦給朋友！
comments.author: Guest User
comments.quoteEn: The setting is first rate. The courtyard fence is covered in flowers of a lot of different kinds and it has clearly been tended carefully. There is an enormous pool, clear and bright, though it was too cold to get in, and it must be wonderful in summer. The room is very clean and it is quiet at night, so I slept until I woke on my own. A very satisfying break. I have already recommended it to friends.

comments.quote: 第一次遇到這麼細緻的房東，入住前提前溝通，民宿內設施齊全，還可以打籃球，院子超大，泳池也很大，入住體驗很棒，下次來莫干山還住這！
